description: Angular component for a single switch widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling display, styling, and toggle logic.

classes.name: SingleSwitchWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for a customizable toggle switch widget with styling and resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, styles, labels, and RPC value handlers.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up auto-scaling and resize observer after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and CSS classes on destruction.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Additional initialization, sets border radius style.

methods.name: onToggleChange
methods.description: Handles toggle switch click, updates RPC value accordingly.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Updates internal value state and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Updates disabled state and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts scaling and layout based on component size.
